_batch.Spelling: No cross-item pattern found. Keys are spread exactly 7/7/7/7 across A-D (A: 1,9,13,14,19,23,28; B: 5,7,10,16,21,24,25; C: 3,6,8,17,18,22,26; D: 2,4,11,12,15,20,27). The key sentence's length rank by word count is also roughly uniform (longest in 7 items, 2nd in 6, 3rd in 8, shortest in 7), so neither the long padded sentence nor the short one signals the answer. Every option carries one challenging target word, the stems are identical, and there are no capitals, marks or wording that differ systematically for the key. The only cue is the misspelled word itself, which is the construct; one minor non-pattern note is that each item has exactly one error so a student confident in three words can eliminate to the fourth, which is inherent to the format.
